name: Glass Car Dash
tagline: Live MPH speed and head-nod break reminders
description: Live phone GPS speed with the Silverline gauge. Automatically learns and slowly adjusts the reference head pose, with small movements allowed. Two separate downward nods trigger a Take a break reminder, with a 750 ms pause per counted nod. Pose setup status appears only on the phone. Tap to dismiss; double-tap to exit. This motion heuristic does not confirm drowsiness.
author: Usman Kayani

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Uses your phone’s GPS to show current speed in miles per hour.
